review.method: Source evidence and membership consistency checked during authoring; not a blind pair-first review.
review.limitation: Small authored examples for policy and pipeline checks, never accuracy claims or held-out evaluation.

items.text: Lantern Festival access route: the temporary ramp at the east door needs a second handrail before the public rehearsal.
items.rationale: Physical access route repair.

items.text: Photo transcription: EAST ENTRANCE. Second rail fitted. Ramp slope checked at rehearsal; the mat still curls at its lower edge.
items.rationale: Same entrance ramp after installation.

items.text: I renamed the east ramp checklist to Step-free arrival. Keep the old rail measurements; the only remaining task is securing that curled mat.
items.rationale: Explicit rename continues the same work, not a new thread.

items.text: Lantern Festival live captions: borrow a tablet for the speech-to-text operator and check that the projector can display two lines at once.
items.rationale: Accessibility work related to the event but distinct from the ramp.

items.text: Video transcript of the caption rehearsal: the last word disappears when a speaker pauses. The tablet still sends the complete sentence to the projector.
items.rationale: Caption pipeline diagnostic, not physical access.

items.text: For the festival's speech display, disable the auto-clear timer. Two-line captions now remain visible through a pause.
items.rationale: Paraphrased continuation without repeating the tablet wording.

items.text: Community garden: order replacement mesh for the pea bed after the pigeons pulled out the seedlings.
items.rationale: Separate gardening activity.

items.text: Garden receipt: fine bird mesh for the pea bed, collected on Wednesday. Pegs supplied with the roll.
items.rationale: Receipt for the same garden repair.

items.text: Festival handover: Maya will secure the east ramp mat, and Ben will retest caption persistence during pauses. Both checks must finish before doors open.
items.rationale: Contains substantive next actions for both threads; sharing this source must not merge them.

items.text: The check went well. Please ask Maya to bring the spare one before we open.
items.rationale: Neither the check nor spare item is identified; the name alone cannot assign a thread.

items.text: Cedar Court, flat 8: water appears below the shower tray only while the shower is running. Plumber's estimate 104 covers resealing the waste fitting.
items.rationale: Shower waste repair in flat8.

items.text: Plumber estimate 104 — Cedar Court flat 8, shower waste reseal, access through the removable bath panel. Roof work excluded.
items.rationale: Invoice identifies the shower, not just the shared number.

items.text: Correction to the flat eight shower log: the ceiling stayed dry for twenty minutes, not two. The newly sealed waste fitting held during the longer test.
items.rationale: Corrected duration is a revision of the same repair.

items.text: Cedar Court roof: rain enters around the stairwell skylight. Roofer's estimate 104 is for replacing the lifted flashing.
items.rationale: Same property and invoice number from a different contractor; separate leak.

items.text: Roof inspection transcript: water tracks underneath the skylight flashing when we spray the uphill corner. The stairwell stain grows; apartments are not being tested.
items.rationale: Locates ingress at the roof.

items.text: The skylight flashing was replaced this morning. Schedule the stairwell repaint after the next rain confirms the roof is dry.
items.rationale: Roof job continuation without invoice code.

items.text: My folding bicycle skips gears under load. Order a new rear shift cable before the commute gets longer next month.
items.rationale: Unrelated personal bicycle maintenance.

items.text: The folder shifts cleanly after replacing its frayed rear cable. Keep the old housing; there was no kink in it.
items.rationale: Paraphrase of the same bicycle repair.

items.text: Cedar Court access schedule: let the plumber into flat eight to test the shower seal at nine, then give the roofer the stairwell key for the skylight flashing check at eleven.
items.rationale: Coordinates two repairs without turning them into one leak.

items.text: Torn invoice corner: estimate 104, balance payable after the water test. Contractor name and site description are missing.
items.rationale: Conflicting invoice number is insufficient to choose either repair.

items.text: Cress cold-storage study: refrigerate half of lot Willow before sowing. Germination after storage is the outcome; all trays receive plain water.
items.rationale: Storage temperature experiment.

items.text: Bench sheet: Willow, refrigerated half, 18 of 24 emerged. Room-stored half, 21 of 24. Plain water in every tray.
items.rationale: Measurements identify the temperature comparison.

items.text: For the chilled cress trial, repeat the count tomorrow; two shoots were hidden by the tray rim. No change to the storage groups.
items.rationale: Same experiment with paraphrased name.

items.text: Cress salinity study also uses lot Willow. Store every seed at room temperature; compare plain water with two salt concentrations after sowing.
items.rationale: Same species and lot but different intervention and project.

items.text: Salinity tray recording: the high-salt group has shorter roots than the plain-water control. Count seedlings before taking the root photographs.
items.rationale: Continues salinity measurements.

items.text: Amend the salt protocol: solutions are 5 and 10 millimolar, not percent. Relabel both Willow treatment bottles before repeating the root measurements.
items.rationale: Unit correction stays within the salinity thread.

items.text: Portfolio site: make the photography page keyboard accessible. The thumbnail modal currently traps focus after closing.
items.rationale: Unrelated website accessibility task.

items.text: The portfolio gallery now returns keyboard focus to the thumbnail that opened it. Verify Escape closes the image dialog as well.
items.rationale: Same website bug after a fix.

items.text: Willow seed allocation: reserve 48 for the refrigerated versus room-storage experiment, and 72 for the three watering conditions in the salinity experiment. Keep outcome sheets separate.
items.rationale: Allocation supplies both trials; it does not equate the experimental objectives.

items.text: The Willow control looks healthy today. Take another photograph before moving the tray.
items.rationale: Both trials have a Willow control; no intervention identifies it.

items.text: Harbor Voices long episode: assemble the retired ferry pilot's interview chronologically. Keep the full storm rescue account after the childhood section.
items.rationale: Long-form interview edit.

items.text: In the ferry pilot's full interview cut, remove the repeated childhood question but leave her pause before the storm rescue story.
items.rationale: Same episode edit despite not repeating the series title.

items.text: Harbor Voices episode export is 42 minutes. The childhood section now leads directly into the rescue account with the original pause intact.
items.rationale: Completion of the full episode change.

items.text: Harbor Voices launch trailer: make a 30-second vertical teaser from the ferry pilot interview. Use the rescue line first, then the release date.
items.rationale: Separate deliverable using the same interview source.

items.text: Vertical teaser review: the pilot's rescue line ends at twelve seconds. Place the release-date card before the closing wave sound.
items.rationale: Trailer-specific timing and layout.

items.text: Trailer timeline screenshot transcription: 00:00 rescue quote; 00:12 release date; 00:27 Harbor Voices logo; total 00:30.
items.rationale: Timeline describes only the trailer, not every work sharing the logo.

items.text: Passport renewal: retake the photograph because the background shadow failed the upload check. Keep the application reference in the appointment email.
items.rationale: Unrelated administration.

items.text: Renewal upload confirmation: replacement passport photograph accepted. Appointment remains Friday at 10:20.
items.rationale: Confirmation continues the same renewal.

items.text: Harbor Voices release checklist: export the full ferry interview with chapter marks and export the thirty-second vertical trailer with burned-in captions. Archive each edit session separately.
items.rationale: One checklist applies to both deliverables without combining their histories.

items.text: The rescue line is too quiet. Bring it up a little and send me the new export.
items.rationale: The line appears in both edits; requested export is unspecified.
